10a8(mdo sde): skyong khyod skye bo mang po bde ba dang /lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang /phan pa dang da ltar dang /ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yongs su gzung ba'i phyir/
10b1(mdo sde): de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'dri 'dri bar sems pa ni legs so//yul 'khor skyong khyod de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang /ngas khyod la bshad do//bcom 
10b2(mdo sde): ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis/bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//
10b3(mdo sde): yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na/yongs su dag pa 'di dag 'thob bo//bzhi gang zhe na/'di lta ste/bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam 
10b4(mdo sde): pas nan gtan byed pa dang /sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa dang /stong pa nyid sgom pa dang /ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa ste/yul 'khor skyong byang chub
10b5(mdo sde): sems dpa' sems dpa' che po//chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na/yongs su dang pa 'di dag 'thob bo/'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/de la 'di skad ces bya'o//
10b6(mdo sde): bsam pa thag pas rtag tu mngon brtson pa//byang chub lam las mi ldog yid ldan pa//g.yo med tha ba med cing rgyu med pa//ye shes mtha' yas ldan la de dag yod//skye 
10b7(mdo sde): dang na dang rga dang 'chis gzir ba//sems can mgon med sdug bsngal mthong nas ni//srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba bsgral ba'i phyir//de dag chos kyi gru ni yang dag sbyor//
10b8(mdo sde): des pa sems can kun la sems mnyam pa//bu gcig pa bzhin 'gro ba rnams la lta//'di dag thams cad bdag gis dgrol lo zhes//gang zag mchog gi bsam pa de 'dra'o//
11a1(mdo sde): @#//stong nyid rtag tu rtogs par khong du chud/bdag yod ma yin sems can yod ma yin/'dus byas sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra ba la//byis pa mi mkhas 'di la rnam par rmongs//
11a2(mdo sde): mkhas pa de dag ji skad tshig smras pa//de la nan tan byed cing kun tu gnas//dul zhing zhi la rtag tu skyon rnams spangs//rgyal ba'i sras rnams byang chub lam la dga'//yul 'khor
11a3(mdo sde): skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbugs 'byin pa 'thob pa ste/bzhi gang zhe na/gzungs 'thob pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed pa dang /chos

11a5(mdo sde): 'byin pa 'thob pa'o//'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/de la 'di skad ces bya'o//gang gis sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa'i chos mchog 'dzin 'gyur ba//
11a6(mdo sde): gzungs rnams grags pa chen po de dag gis ni rtag tu thob//nam yang chud zar mi 'gyur phyir dang blo gros rab tu 'phel//de dag ye shes chags pa med cing chos kun pha rol phyin//byang
11a7(mdo sde): chub yan lag 'phel bar byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed//de dag 'dren pa rnams ni gang nas bzhud pa'i lam mchog ston//de dag sdig pa'i grogs po dag la sten pa ma yin
11a8(mdo sde): te/tshig byed bdag nyid me ltar de dag ring du rnam par spong //dpa' bo stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i zab mo'i chos thos nas//de dag bdag dang sems can srog tu lta ba kun mi
11b1(mdo sde): 'byung //de dag tshul khrims skyon med dul zhing zhi ba'i yid dang ldan//sangs rgyas tshul khrims bla na med la sems can rnams kyang sbyor//yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni//byang chub
11b2(mdo sde): sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos te/bzhi gang zhe na/yul 'khor skyong sangs rgyas mthong ba/byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khed pa rnams dga' bar
11b3(mdo sde): byed pa'i chos dang /yul 'khor skyong rjes su 'thun pa'i chos thos pa/byang chub sems dpa' 'khed pa rnams dga' ba byed pa'i chos dang /yul khor skyong dmigs su med pa'i chos la bzod pa/
11b4(mdo sde): thams cad yongs su gtong ba/byang chub sems dma' 'khor ba na 'khod pa na 'khod pa rnams dga'/bar byed pa'i chos te/yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag ni/byang chub sems dpa' khor ba na 'khod pa
11b5(mdo sde): byang chub sems dpa' 'khod pa na 'khod pa rnam dga' bar byed pa'i chos//'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/de la 'di skad ces bya'o//gzi brjid kyis ni 'jig rten thams cad kun nas snang mdzad pa'i//rdzogs pa'i

12a2(mdo sde): par mthong na sems ni rab tu dga'//grong dang yul 'khor sa dang srog dang bu dang chung ma dang /thams cad gtong zhing de yi sems ni gang du'ang g.yo ba med//yul 'khor 
12a3(mdo sde): skyong byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi la lta bar mi bya ste/bzhi gang zhe na/yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas khyim gyi gnas la lta bar mi bya ba dang /yul 'khor

12a7(mdo sde): ldan pa des pa de dag dgon par dga' zhing dbang po dul//de dag gang du'ang bud med rnams dang skyes pa dag dang 'dris mi byed//bse ltar gcig pu gnas shing bsam pa dri med 
12a8(mdo sde): dag la dri ma bral//de dag rnyed pa rnams kyis dga' bar mi 'gyur ma thob yid zhum med//'dod pa chung ste ngan ngon tsam la dga' zhing sgyu dang tshul chos spangs//sems can don

12b2(mdo sde): lag rnam spangs te/bsam pa rdo rje lta bur rab brtan rtag tu byang chub lam la sbyor//lus ni dum bu dum bur bcad kyang de dag sems la g.yo ba med//thams cad mkhyen nyid re 
12b3(mdo sde): ba phyir zhing brtson 'grus shin tu brtan 'dir rtsom//yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni//byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gdung ba med par byed pa'i chos te/bzhi gang zhe na/
12b4(mdo sde): yul 'khor skyong tshul khrims skyon med pa byang chub sems dpa' rnamasakyi gdung ba med par byedapa'i chos dang /yul 'khor skyong dgon pa la gnas pa mi 'dor ba byang chub
12b5(mdo sde): sems dpa' rnams kyi gdungab med par byed pa'i chosadang /yul 'khor skyong 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi dang 'thun par byed pa/byang chub sems dpa' rnam
12b6(mdo sde): kyi gdung ba med par byed ba'i chos dang /yul 'khor skyang mang du thos pa thob par byed pa/byang chub kyi sems dpa' rnams kyi gdang ba med par byed pa'i cos te/yul
12b7(mdo sde): 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnam kyi gdung ba med par bye pa'i chos so//'di la 'di ni chos yin te/de la 'di skad ces bya'o//sangs
12b8(mdo sde): rgyas tshul khrims dam pa 'di la 'dod byed cing //tshul khrims dri med nor bu rin chen 'dra ba srung //de dag nga ni khrims ldan legs sdom yin mi shes//tshul
13a1(mdo sde): khrims de nyid gnas rtag tu sems can sbyor//de dag stong pa dgon par rtag tu gnas par byed//de dag bdag gi 'du shes srog gi 'du shes med//
13a2(mdo sde): gzugs sku rtsa dang shing dang rtsig pa 'dra bar mthong //'di la skyes pa bud med bdag gi med par mthong //'phags pa rigs bzhi la dga' zhing g.yo med tshul chos med//bag
13a3(mdo sde): yod de dag bsam pa thag pas rab tu sbyor//thos nas yon tan rnams la rtag tu brtson par byed bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan mthu chen don du gnyer/skye rga 'chi bas bcom
13a4(mdo sde): zhing yun ring nad gzir ba//'gro ba mgon med srid pa'i brtson ra 'dir bltas nas//zhi ba dam pa mchog gi chos kyi gru sbyar te//srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i chu las skye bo
13a5(mdo sde): sgrol bar byed//'dus byas gyur par 'jig rten 'khyam pas skyabs mgon dang /dpung bsnyen byed pa gzhan ni gang yang yod min gyis//bdag gis sems can
13a6(mdo sde): 'di dag thams cad yongs dgrol zhes//de'i phyir byang chub mchog tu bdag gis smon lam btab//yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpa' bzhi po 'di dag ni cang shes
13a7(mdo sde): kyi 'gros su shes par bya ste/bzhi gang zhe na/bde 'gro 'thob ste/de yang sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang phrad pa dang /bla ma la sri zhu byed de/de yang zang zing med pa'i sems kyis
13a8(mdo sde): sten pa dang /bas mtha'i gnas la mngon par dga' ste/de yang rnyed pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba dang /spobs pa thob ste/de yang zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan pa ste/yul 'khor
13b1(mdo sde): skyong byang chub sems dpas chos bzhi po de dag ni/cang shes kyi 'gros su shes par bya'o//'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/de la 'di skad ces bya ste/brtan pa nags dang sul na rtag tu 
13b2(mdo sde): gnas par byed/de dag rtag tu khor mor rnyed pa don gnyer min//chags med blo can rtag tu spob pa ldan pa yin//zab mo'i chos la mkhas shing spobs pa rnams dang bral//rtag tu
13b3(mdo sde): khor mor bla ma rnams la sri zhu byed//de dag ji skad smras pa de bzhin de dag sbyor//bde gshegs dpag tu med pa mang ba mnyes par byed//rgyal ba'i ye shes ched du mchod pa 
13b4(mdo sde): pa rgya chen byed//grags pa chen po rnams kyi 'gro ba gtso bor 'gyur//lha mi rnams kyi nang na spyi bor phyin pa yin//rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam la rtag tu sems can 'dzud//

13b7(mdo sde): sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su sbyong ba'i chos te/bzhi gang zhe na/khong khro ba med pa'i sems byang chub sems dpa'i spyodapa dang /tshul
13b8(mdo sde): 'chos pa dang /kha gsags dang /thobs kyis 'jal ba yongs su spangs te dgon par gnas pa dang /bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong zhing rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa dang /
14a1(mdo sde): nyin mtshan du chos 'dod cing /chos smra ba rnams la 'khrul pa mi tshol ba ste/yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag ni/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi/byang
14a2(mdo sde): chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongasu sbyong ba'i chos so//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigasu bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to//bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod pa na//

18b3(mdo sde): me tog dang //spobs mchog rnams dang gser gyis brgyan pa yi//cod pan dpal ldan dam pa ngas btang ngo //nga sngon rgyal po mos ldan gyur pa'i tshe//shing bal 'da' ma rmel ba lta bu dang //pad+ma'i
